settings.mavlinkSettings.saveCsvTelemetr.shortDescription: Save all vehicle parameters to CSV files at 1 Hz during flight.

settings.mavlinkSettings.sendGCSHeartbea.name: sendGCSHeartbeat
settings.mavlinkSettings.sendGCSHeartbea.shortDescription: Periodically transmit heartbeat messages to inform vehicles that QGC is connected.

settings.mavlinkSettings.telemetrySave.longDescription: If this option is enabled a telemetry will be saved after each flight completes.
settings.mavlinkSettings.telemetrySave.name: telemetrySave
settings.mavlinkSettings.telemetrySave.shortDescription: Automatically save a telemetry log file after each flight completes.

settings.mavlinkSettings.telemetrySaveNo.longDescription: If this option is enabled a telemtry log will be saved even if vehicle was never armed.
settings.mavlinkSettings.telemetrySaveNo.name: telemetrySaveNotArmed
settings.mavlinkSettings.telemetrySaveNo.shortDescription: Also save telemetry logs from sessions where the vehicle was never armed.

settings.ntripSettings.ntripAllowSelfSig.longDescription: Allow connections to NTRIP casters with self-signed TLS certificates. Disabling this rejects self-signed certificates to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks.
settings.ntripSettings.ntripAllowSelfSig.name: ntripAllowSelfSignedCerts

settings.ntripSettings.ntripGgaIntervalS.longDescription: How often to send NMEA GGA sentences upstream to the NTRIP caster. VRS mountpoints typically require 1-10s; set lower for tighter VRS tracking, higher to reduce bandwidth.
settings.ntripSettings.ntripGgaIntervalS.name: ntripGgaIntervalSec

settings.ntripSettings.ntripGgaPositionS.longDescription: Position source for NMEA GGA sentences sent to the NTRIP caster. Auto selects the best available source.
settings.ntripSettings.ntripGgaPositionS.name: ntripGgaPositionSource

settings.ntripSettings.ntripMountpoint.longDescription: NTRIP mount point. Leave blank for RTCM over TCP
settings.ntripSettings.ntripMountpoint.name: ntripMountpoint

settings.ntripSettings.ntripServerConnec.longDescription: Connect to NTRIP server using specified address/port
settings.ntripSettings.ntripServerConnec.name: ntripServerConnectEnabled

settings.ntripSettings.ntripUdpForwardEn.longDescription: Forward received RTCM correction data via UDP to the specified address and port
settings.ntripSettings.ntripUdpForwardEn.name: ntripUdpForwardEnabled
settings.ntripSettings.ntripUdpForwardEn.shortDescription: Forward received RTCM correction data to another application via UDP.

settings.ntripSettings.ntripUdpTargetAdd.longDescription: IP address to forward RTCM data to via UDP
settings.ntripSettings.ntripUdpTargetAdd.name: ntripUdpTargetAddress
settings.ntripSettings.ntripUdpTargetAdd.shortDescription: IP address to forward RTCM correction data to.

settings.ntripSettings.ntripUdpTargetPor.longDescription: Port to forward RTCM data to via UDP
settings.ntripSettings.ntripUdpTargetPor.name: ntripUdpTargetPort
settings.ntripSettings.ntripUdpTargetPor.shortDescription: Port number for forwarding RTCM correction data via UDP.

settings.ntripSettings.ntripUseTls.longDescription: Connect using TLS/SSL encryption (required for some SPARTN casters on port 2102)
settings.ntripSettings.ntripUseTls.name: ntripUseTls

settings.ntripSettings.ntripWhitelist.longDescription: Comma-separated RTCM message IDs to forward (e.g. 1005,1077,1087). Leave blank for all messages.
settings.ntripSettings.ntripWhitelist.name: ntripWhitelist
settings.ntripSettings.ntripWhitelist.shortDescription: Comma-separated RTCM message IDs to forward. Leave blank for all messages.

settings.ntripSettings.rtcmUdpInputEnabl.longDescription: Listen on a UDP port for incoming RTCM3 correction data and forward it to connected vehicles via MAVLink GPS_RTCM_DATA.
settings.ntripSettings.rtcmUdpInputEnabl.name: rtcmUdpInputEnabled

settings.ntripSettings.rtcmUdpInputPort.longDescription: UDP port to listen on for incoming RTCM3 correction data.
settings.ntripSettings.rtcmUdpInputPort.name: rtcmUdpInputPort

settings.ntripSettings.rtcmUdpValidate.longDescription: Enable validation of incoming data as RTCM and drop garbage (improves security).
settings.ntripSettings.rtcmUdpValidate.name: rtcmUdpValidate

settings.offlineMapsSettings.maxTilesFor.name: maxTilesForDownload
settings.offlineMapsSettings.maxTilesFor.shortDescription: Maximum number of tiles for download.

settings.packetRadioSettings.alinkEnable.longDescription: Let the ground station tell the drone to adjust bitrate and FEC as signal quality changes
settings.packetRadioSettings.alinkEnable.name: alinkEnabled

settings.packetRadioSettings.channel.longDescription: Wi-Fi channel the drone transmits on. Must match the drone's packet radio channel.
settings.packetRadioSettings.channel.name: channel

settings.packetRadioSettings.deviceName.longDescription: Which USB adapter to receive with. Leave empty to use the first supported adapter found.
settings.packetRadioSettings.deviceName.name: deviceName

settings.packetRadioSettings.enabled.longDescription: Receive video and telemetry from a wfb-ng packet radio link using a USB Wi-Fi adapter plugged into this computer
settings.packetRadioSettings.enabled.name: enabled

settings.packetRadioSettings.keyFile.longDescription: Path to the ground station key matching the drone's keypair. Leave empty to use the built-in OpenIPC default key.
settings.packetRadioSettings.keyFile.name: keyFile

settings.planViewSettings.allowMultipleL.name: allowMultipleLandingPatterns
settings.planViewSettings.allowMultipleL.shortDescription: Enable creating multiple landing sequences for Return-to-Launch contingency selection.

settings.planViewSettings.displayPresets.name: displayPresetsTabFirst
settings.planViewSettings.displayPresets.shortDescription: Display the presets tab at start

settings.planViewSettings.showGimbalOnly.name: showGimbalOnlyWhenSet
settings.planViewSettings.showGimbalOnly.shortDescription: Show gimbal yaw visual only when set explicitly for the waypoint

settings.planViewSettings.showMissionIte.name: showMissionItemStatus
settings.planViewSettings.showMissionIte.shortDescription: Show/Hide the mission item status display

settings.planViewSettings.takeoffItemNot.name: takeoffItemNotRequired
settings.planViewSettings.takeoffItemNot.shortDescription: Allow missions to begin without a dedicated takeoff waypoint.

settings.planViewSettings.useConditionGa.name: useConditionGate
settings.planViewSettings.useConditionGa.shortDescription: Use MAV_CMD_CONDITION_GATE for mission pattern transitions instead of standard waypoints.

settings.planViewSettings.vtolTransition.name: vtolTransitionDistance
settings.planViewSettings.vtolTransition.shortDescription: Distance required for VTOL vehicles to complete altitude and speed transitions.

settings.remoteIDSettings.altitudeFixed.longDescription: Fixed Altitude to send on SYSTEM message
settings.remoteIDSettings.altitudeFixed.name: altitudeFixed
settings.remoteIDSettings.altitudeFixed.shortDescription: Fixed altitude for operator location when not using live GNSS.

settings.remoteIDSettings.basicID.name: basicID
settings.remoteIDSettings.basicID.shortDescription: Drone serial number or registration code to transmit (max 20 characters).

settings.remoteIDSettings.basicIDUaType.name: basicIDUaType
settings.remoteIDSettings.basicIDUaType.shortDescription: Classification of the unmanned aircraft (multirotor, fixed-wing, etc.).

settings.remoteIDSettings.categoryEU.longDescription: Category of the UAS in the EU region
settings.remoteIDSettings.categoryEU.name: categoryEU
settings.remoteIDSettings.categoryEU.shortDescription: EU classification category for the UAS.

settings.remoteIDSettings.classEU.longDescription: Class of the UAS in the EU region
settings.remoteIDSettings.classEU.name: classEU

settings.remoteIDSettings.classification.name: classificationType
settings.remoteIDSettings.classification.shortDescription: Classification standard to use for Remote ID.

settings.remoteIDSettings.latitudeFixed.longDescription: Fixed latitude to send on SYSTEM message
settings.remoteIDSettings.latitudeFixed.name: latitudeFixed
settings.remoteIDSettings.latitudeFixed.shortDescription: Fixed latitude for operator location when not using live GNSS.

settings.remoteIDSettings.locationType.name: locationType
settings.remoteIDSettings.locationType.shortDescription: Source for operator location data (live GNSS or fixed coordinates).

settings.remoteIDSettings.longitudeFixed.longDescription: Fixed Longitude to send on SYSTEM message
settings.remoteIDSettings.longitudeFixed.name: longitudeFixed
settings.remoteIDSettings.longitudeFixed.shortDescription: Fixed longitude for operator location when not using live GNSS.

settings.remoteIDSettings.operatorIDEU.longDescription: EU Operator ID. Enter the full 19 or 20 character ID including the 3 secret characters; only the 16 character public part is stored and broadcast.
settings.remoteIDSettings.operatorIDEU.name: operatorIDEU
settings.remoteIDSettings.operatorIDEU.shortDescription: Pilot registration code or identification number.

settings.remoteIDSettings.operatorIDFAA.name: operatorIDFAA
settings.remoteIDSettings.operatorIDFAA.shortDescription: Pilot registration code or identification number.

settings.remoteIDSettings.operatorIDType.name: operatorIDType
settings.remoteIDSettings.operatorIDType.shortDescription: Format of the operator ID (currently CAA only).

settings.remoteIDSettings.region.longDescription: The region of operation the mission will take place in
settings.remoteIDSettings.region.name: region
settings.remoteIDSettings.region.shortDescription: Regulatory region for Remote ID compliance.

settings.remoteIDSettings.selfIDEmergenc.longDescription: Optional plain text for operator to specify operations data (Emergency Text). Maximum 23 characters.
settings.remoteIDSettings.selfIDEmergenc.name: selfIDEmergency
settings.remoteIDSettings.selfIDEmergenc.shortDescription: Emergency status text to broadcast (max 23 characters).

settings.remoteIDSettings.selfIDExtended.longDescription: Optional plain text for operator to specify operations data (Extended Text). Maximum 23 characters.
settings.remoteIDSettings.selfIDExtended.name: selfIDExtended
settings.remoteIDSettings.selfIDExtended.shortDescription: Extended operational status information to broadcast (max 23 characters).

settings.remoteIDSettings.selfIDFree.longDescription: Optional plain text for operator to specify operations data (Free Text). Maximum 23 characters.
settings.remoteIDSettings.selfIDFree.name: selfIDFree
settings.remoteIDSettings.selfIDFree.shortDescription: Flight purpose description to broadcast (max 23 characters).

settings.remoteIDSettings.selfIDType.name: selfIDType
settings.remoteIDSettings.selfIDType.shortDescription: Type of self-ID message to broadcast.

settings.remoteIDSettings.sendBasicID.longDescription: When enabled, sends basic ID message
settings.remoteIDSettings.sendBasicID.name: sendBasicID
settings.remoteIDSettings.sendBasicID.shortDescription: Broadcast the drone identification information via Remote ID.

settings.remoteIDSettings.sendOperatorID.longDescription: When enabled, sends operator ID message
settings.remoteIDSettings.sendOperatorID.name: sendOperatorID
settings.remoteIDSettings.sendOperatorID.shortDescription: Broadcast the operator identification information via Remote ID.

settings.remoteIDSettings.sendSelfID.longDescription: When enabled, sends self ID message
settings.remoteIDSettings.sendSelfID.name: sendSelfID
settings.remoteIDSettings.sendSelfID.shortDescription: Broadcast flight purpose or emergency status information via Remote ID.

settings.rtkSettings.fixedBasePositionAc.longDescription: Defines the accuracy of the fixed RTK base position.
settings.rtkSettings.fixedBasePositionAc.name: fixedBasePositionAccuracy

settings.rtkSettings.fixedBasePositionAl.longDescription: Defines the altitude of the fixed RTK base position.
settings.rtkSettings.fixedBasePositionAl.name: fixedBasePositionAltitude

settings.rtkSettings.fixedBasePositionLa.longDescription: Defines the latitude of the fixed RTK base position.
settings.rtkSettings.fixedBasePositionLa.name: fixedBasePositionLatitude

settings.rtkSettings.fixedBasePositionLo.longDescription: Defines the longitude of the fixed RTK base position.
settings.rtkSettings.fixedBasePositionLo.name: fixedBasePositionLongitude

settings.rtkSettings.surveyInAccuracyLim.longDescription: The minimum accuracy value that Survey-In must achieve before it can complete.
settings.rtkSettings.surveyInAccuracyLim.name: surveyInAccuracyLimit

settings.rtkSettings.surveyInMinObservat.longDescription: Defines the minimum amount of observation time for the position calculation.
settings.rtkSettings.surveyInMinObservat.name: surveyInMinObservationDuration

settings.rtkSettings.useFixedBasePositio.longDescription: Specify the mode for the RTK base 0: Survey-In (Fixed + Auto) 1: Specify position (Fixed + Manual)
settings.rtkSettings.useFixedBasePositio.name: useFixedBasePosition

settings.unitsSettings.customUnits.longDescription: If this option is enabled each measurement unit is chosen individually instead of following a metric or imperial preset.
settings.unitsSettings.customUnits.name: customUnits

settings.videoSettings.activeVideoSource.longDescription: Index of the configured video source displayed as the main view. 0 = Camera 1, 1..N = additional cameras.
settings.videoSettings.activeVideoSource.name: activeVideoSource
settings.videoSettings.activeVideoSource.shortDescription: Index of the configured video source displayed as the main view.

settings.videoSettings.aspectRatio.longDescription: Video Aspect Ratio (width / height). Use 0.0 to ignore it.
settings.videoSettings.aspectRatio.name: aspectRatio
settings.videoSettings.aspectRatio.shortDescription: Video frame aspect ratio as width divided by height. Use 0 to auto-detect.

settings.videoSettings.disablePixelAspec.longDescription: QGC normally inserts a pixel-aspect-ratio=1/1 capsfilter so non-square-pixel sources (some RTSP cams, DVB) don't render geometrically distorted. A few v4l2 drivers without VIDIOC_CROPCAP deadlock negotiation when PAR is forced; enable this option as a workaround. Takes effect on next stream restart.
settings.videoSettings.disablePixelAspec.name: disablePixelAspectRatio
settings.videoSettings.disablePixelAspec.shortDescription: Skip the PAR=1/1 capsfilter in the CPU video sink path.

settings.videoSettings.disableWhenDisarm.longDescription: Disables the video stream when the vehicle is disarmed.
settings.videoSettings.disableWhenDisarm.name: disableWhenDisarmed
settings.videoSettings.disableWhenDisarm.shortDescription: Disables the video stream when the vehicle is disarmed to save bandwidth.

settings.videoSettings.enableStorageLimi.longDescription: When enabled, old video files will be auto-deleted when the total size of QGC-recorded video exceeds the maximum video storage usage.
settings.videoSettings.enableStorageLimi.name: enableStorageLimit
settings.videoSettings.enableStorageLimi.shortDescription: Automatically delete oldest recordings when the storage limit is exceeded.

settings.videoSettings.extraVideoSources.longDescription: JSON array of additional camera streams beyond Camera 1. Each entry is an object with 'name', 'source' and 'url' keys.
settings.videoSettings.extraVideoSources.name: extraVideoSources

settings.videoSettings.forceCpuVideoPath.longDescription: By default, when a hardware decoder produces GPU-backed frames (DMABuf, GLMemory, D3D11, IOSurface, AHardwareBuffer), the pipeline imports them directly into Qt's render thread to avoid a per-frame CPU copy. The pipeline already falls back to the CPU path automatically when a GPU import fails, so this option is only needed for debugging or to work around a broken driver.
settings.videoSettings.forceCpuVideoPath.name: forceCpuVideoPath
settings.videoSettings.forceCpuVideoPath.shortDescription: Force the video pipeline to copy frames through CPU instead of importing GPU memory directly.

settings.videoSettings.forceVideoDecoder.longDescription: Force the change of prioritization between video decode methods, allowing the user to force some video hardware decode plugins if necessary.
settings.videoSettings.forceVideoDecoder.name: forceVideoDecoder
settings.videoSettings.forceVideoDecoder.shortDescription: Override automatic video decoder selection to force a specific decoding method.

settings.videoSettings.gridLines.longDescription: Displays a grid overlaid over the video view.
settings.videoSettings.gridLines.name: gridLines

settings.videoSettings.lowLatencyMode.longDescription: If this option is enabled, the rtpjitterbuffer is removed and the video sink is set to assynchronous mode, reducing the latency by about 200 ms.
settings.videoSettings.lowLatencyMode.name: lowLatencyMode
settings.videoSettings.lowLatencyMode.shortDescription: Reduce video latency by approximately 200ms using optimized streaming settings.

settings.videoSettings.maxVideoSize.longDescription: Maximum amount of disk space used by video recording.
settings.videoSettings.maxVideoSize.name: maxVideoSize
settings.videoSettings.maxVideoSize.shortDescription: Maximum disk space available for video recording storage.

settings.videoSettings.multiViewEnabled.longDescription: When enabled, additional cameras are shown as picture-in-picture tiles next to the main view instead of only when switched to.
settings.videoSettings.multiViewEnabled.name: multiViewEnabled
settings.videoSettings.multiViewEnabled.shortDescription: Show additional cameras as picture-in-picture tiles next to the main view.

settings.videoSettings.primaryCameraName.longDescription: Optional display name for the primary camera (Camera 1).
settings.videoSettings.primaryCameraName.name: primaryCameraName
settings.videoSettings.primaryCameraName.shortDescription: Optional display name for the primary camera (Camera 1).

settings.videoSettings.recordingFormat.name: recordingFormat
settings.videoSettings.recordingFormat.shortDescription: File format for saved video recordings.

settings.videoSettings.rtpJitterLatencyM.longDescription: Latency budget for the RTP jitter buffer (rtspsrc.latency / rtpjitterbuffer.latency / webrtcbin.latency for WHEP). Lower = less glass-to-glass delay; higher = more headroom for packet reordering and retransmission. The default of 80 ms allows RFC 4588 retransmission to recover lost packets before the playout deadline; values <40 ms effectively disable retransmission. Ignored when Low Latency Mode is enabled.
settings.videoSettings.rtpJitterLatencyM.name: rtpJitterLatencyMs

settings.videoSettings.rtspAutoReconnect.longDescription: When enabled, the receiver reconnects with exponential backoff (1s → 30s) after a stream timeout or a fatal pipeline error. Disable to fall back to the legacy behaviour of giving up after one failure.
settings.videoSettings.rtspAutoReconnect.name: rtspAutoReconnect
settings.videoSettings.rtspAutoReconnect.shortDescription: Automatically restart the pipeline on watchdog timeout or pipeline error.

settings.videoSettings.rtspTimeout.longDescription: How long to wait for stream data before restarting the connection. Covers RTSP negotiation and WebRTC (WHEP) signaling/ICE setup.
settings.videoSettings.rtspTimeout.name: rtspTimeout
settings.videoSettings.rtspTimeout.shortDescription: How long to wait for stream data before restarting the connection.

settings.videoSettings.rtspUrl.longDescription: RTSP url address and port to bind to for video stream. Example: rtsp://192.168.42.1:554/live
settings.videoSettings.rtspUrl.name: rtspUrl
settings.videoSettings.rtspUrl.shortDescription: Network address for RTSP video stream (e.g. rtsp://192.168.42.1:554/live).

settings.videoSettings.showRecControl.longDescription: Show recording control in the UI.
settings.videoSettings.showRecControl.name: showRecControl

settings.videoSettings.tcpUrl.longDescription: TCP url address and port to bind to for video stream. Example: 192.168.143.200:3001
settings.videoSettings.tcpUrl.name: tcpUrl
settings.videoSettings.tcpUrl.shortDescription: Network address and port for TCP video stream (e.g. 192.168.143.200:3001).

settings.videoSettings.udpUrl.longDescription: UDP url address and port to bind to for video stream. Example: 0.0.0.0:5600
settings.videoSettings.udpUrl.name: udpUrl
settings.videoSettings.udpUrl.shortDescription: Network address and port for UDP video stream (e.g. 0.0.0.0:5600).

settings.videoSettings.videoConversionEl.longDescription: Leave blank to auto-probe (SoC-native imxvideoconvert_g2d / nvvidconv when present, otherwise videoconvert). Set to a specific GStreamer factory name to force that element. Used as a workaround when an SoC's preferred element has a defect; takes effect on next stream restart.
settings.videoSettings.videoConversionEl.name: videoConversionElement
settings.videoSettings.videoConversionEl.shortDescription: Override the GStreamer color-conversion element used in the CPU video sink path.

settings.videoSettings.videoSource.longDescription: Source for video. UDP, TCP, RTSP and UVC Cameras may be supported depending on Vehicle and ground station version.
settings.videoSettings.videoSource.name: videoSource
settings.videoSettings.videoSource.shortDescription: Source for video stream (UDP, TCP, RTSP, or connected USB camera).

settings.videoSettings.whepUrl.longDescription: WebRTC WHEP endpoint url for video stream. Example: https://sfu.example.com/whep/stream
settings.videoSettings.whepUrl.name: whepUrl
settings.videoSettings.whepUrl.shortDescription: WebRTC WHEP endpoint url for video stream (e.g. https://sfu.example.com/whep/stream).

settings.viewer3DSettings.altitudeBias.name: altitudeBias
settings.viewer3DSettings.altitudeBias.shortDescription: Vertical offset for vehicle rendering in the 3D viewer.

settings.viewer3DSettings.buildingLevelH.name: buildingLevelHeight
settings.viewer3DSettings.buildingLevelH.shortDescription: Average floor-to-floor height used for 3D building visualization.

settings.viewer3DSettings.enabled.name: enabled
settings.viewer3DSettings.enabled.shortDescription: Enable 3D terrain and building visualization alongside the 2D map.

settings.viewer3DSettings.keepSceneAlive.name: keepSceneAlive
settings.viewer3DSettings.keepSceneAlive.shortDescription: Keep the 3D scene loaded in memory when switching back to fly view. Disable on memory-constrained devices.

settings.viewer3DSettings.mapProvider.name: mapProvider
settings.viewer3DSettings.mapProvider.shortDescription: Data source for 3D map terrain and building information.

settings.viewer3DSettings.osmFilePath.name: osmFilePath
settings.viewer3DSettings.osmFilePath.shortDescription: Path to an offline OpenStreetMap file for 3D terrain rendering.
